latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Text To Video.

- Convert text, DOCX, PDF, SRT, or TXT scripts (up to 200MB) into YouTube-ready 1080p MP4 videos.
- Fast cloud GPU processing: typical jobs complete in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple setup with either user token or automatic anonymous access (100 free credits).
- Upload your file and describe your desired video; AI handles voiceover, captions, and export.
- Includes support for previewing timeline, checking credits, and batch or iterative workflows.
